description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Scott] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Scott
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Scott after using two Spellblade abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Scott

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
